Type: round wood cutout side table
Use: holding a lamp or drinks beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: rustic, contemporary, Japandi
Materials: solid elm wood, wire-brushed weathered finish
Colors: warm natural wood, light greyish brown
Shape: solid cylinder drum with large rounded cutout, open lower shelf, flat round top, chunky and sculptural, compact
Feel: warm, organic, earthy
Goes with: linen, white walls, rattan and greenery; rustic, Japandi or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Miramar Elm Wood Cutout Side End Table, 19.7"D, Natural
product.description: Beautiful texture and grain, combined with clever modern side openings, give this end table the appearance of a hollowed-out log. It's the perfect place for a houseplant, lamp, or cup of coffee, and a handsome conversation piece all in one. 19.7" Diameter, 21.65"H Elm wood shows natural grain A modern rustic piece that works with modern and modern farmhouse décor Sturdy and durable with display space for magazines or a laptop underneath No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
